verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission features a four-person crew.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, and Christina Hammock Koch, and CSA astronaut Jeremy Hansen" (R1); "The four Artemis II astronauts" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly state the crew consists of four astronauts.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew consists of NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and CSA astronaut Jeremy Hansen.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, and Christina Hammock Koch, and CSA astronaut Jeremy Hansen" (R1, R4); identical in R5, R6, R7
verifications.reasoning: Exact crew composition and affiliations listed in multiple sources.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew successfully completed a 10-day mission around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "10-day mission" (R1, R2); "nearly 10-day journey" (R7); "9 days, 1 hour, 32 minutes" (R9)
verifications.reasoning: Sources commonly describe it as a 10-day mission, though precise duration is slightly under 10 days; directly supported.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew splashed down in the Pacific Ocean on April 10, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego at 5:07 p.m. local time Friday" (R2); April 10, 2026 confirmed in R7, R9
verifications.reasoning: Exact date, location, and ocean match across sources.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission is the first crewed lunar mission in over 50 years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "first crewed flight beyond low Earth orbit since 1972" (R2); "first time since 1972" (R1)
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm first crewed lunar mission since Apollo 17 in 1972.
